card.text: Explore China in 3D with its published shape model and documented physical size scale.

introduction.text: Published lightcurve reconstruction, with an approximate size from infrared observations. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Light-curve shape model
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Thermal diameter 26.084 ± 0.199 km; quoted fit error excludes about 10% systematic uncertainty and shape/aspect effects. The convex model shows broad shape; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 13.042 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
